subject: Consolidated verification package and actionable remediation for Trilogy inference disruption
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Nate Reynolds <nate@trilogy.com>, trilogy-support@trilogy.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidated verification package and actionable remediation for Trilogy inference disruption

Hi Nate / Trilogy team,

Thanks again for your patience while we completed our internal analysis. Attached is a concise verification package that we prepared to support your compliance review and to confirm the mitigations we've implemented since the disruption on Jan 14. The bundle includes: an executive RCA summary, a time-ordered log bundle (redacted for PII), and a verification playbook sheet that lists what we will run with your team during the verification call.

Key takeaways (short):
- Root cause: an autoscaling race between a new model-variant rollout and adaptive batching that caused a KV-cache eviction storm for sessions with long-lived prefixes. The eviction produced transient token duplication/loss for ~0.06% of API calls between 21:07-21:26 UTC on Jan 14.
- Impact: latency spikes and intermittent token truncation for a subset of your high-throughput routes; no evidence of raw customer data exfiltration.
- Immediate mitigations already applied: rollback of the variant rollout, conservative batching window enforced, and cache-protection guardrails for pinned sessions.
- Action items we own: 1) deterministic replay & artifact delivery, 2) runbook additions and automated gating for rollouts, 3) a follow-up verification run with your engineering and compliance teams.

Requested from you: please confirm whether your security/compliance team needs additional redactions or a notarized artifact package. If you can confirm a 60-90 minute slot next week for the verification run we will coordinate engineers + SREs.

Attachments: trilogy_20260115_rca_summary.pdf; token_loss_log_bundle_20260115.tar.gz; verification_playbook_20260128.xlsx

I will follow with a short note from Jonas with the technical replay and exact artifacts we plan to hand over.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Principal Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: trilogy_20260115_rca_summary.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: token_loss_log_bundle_20260115.tar.gz (application/gzip)]
From: Nate Reynolds <nate@trilogy.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 08:41:23 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated verification package and actionable remediation for Trilogy inference disruption

Mina — thanks for the rapid turnaround and the materials. A couple quick clarifying questions before we kick off the verification session:

1) Can you confirm whether any of the affected calls included tokens that contained personally identifiable information (PII) or payment instrument data? Our compliance team needs a yes/no and, if yes, a scope (number of sessions / sample IDs).
2) For the deterministic replay, is there an option to run it against sanitized inputs (we prefer sanitized replays for our auditors) and still reproduce the failure mode?

If you can also share the proposed times for next week I will loop in our engineering manager and security lead.

—Nate
Nate Reynolds
Head of Platform Engineering
Trilogy Finance
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Nate Reynolds <nate@trilogy.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidated verification package and actionable remediation for Trilogy inference disruption

Nate — short technical note to answer your two points, and to list the artifacts we can provide today.

1) PII/payment data scope: Our audit of the logs shows no tokens that match PII or PAN patterns in the affected token segments. The sample IDs included in the log bundle are hashed with salts and one-way mappings; we can provide a salted-hash mapping under an NDA if needed. Bottom line: we saw no evidence of raw PII leakage.

2) Sanitized deterministic replay: yes — we have a sanitization layer that replaces payload text with synthetic placeholders while preserving tokenization characteristics and session prefix lengths. The replay reproduces the cache eviction timing and token boundary conditions without exposing original content. We validated the replay in our staging cluster and reproduced the token truncation behavior consistently.

Artifacts enclosed in the shared evidence S3:
- replay_manifest.json (indexes sanitized request IDs used in deterministic replay)
- kv_cache_eviction_trace.log (trimmed, timestamped)
- metrics_snapshot_20260114_21-00-22-00.tar (prometheus + p99 traces)

Planned owners & next steps (we will bring these to the verification call):
- Redwood lead: Jonas Weber (replay, logs, SRE coordination)
- Redwood engineering: Grace O'Connor (runtime fixes, rollout gating)
- Redwood CS: Marissa Cole (customer coordination + compliance artifacts)

Proposed verification slots (PST): Tue 2026-01-27 10:00-11:30; Wed 2026-01-28 09:00-10:30 or 14:00-15:30. Please pick one and we will send a calendar invite + temporary access link to the evidence S3.

Thanks all — Wed 2026-01-28 14:00-15:30 PST works for our team. We appreciate Redwood preparing a sanitized replay and the artifacts; our security lead confirmed that a sanitized replay + salted-hash mapping will meet audit requirements for now.

One procedural request before the call: can Redwood provide a short checklist of the specific tests you'll run during the verification (e.g., run replay X against staging-1, validate metric Y p99 before/after, attachment of the signed checklist)? We need a simple artifact we can attach to our internal audit ticket.

If you can send that checklist and the calendar invite we will add our security and product leads.

—Nate

Great — invite sent for Wed 2026-01-28 14:00-15:30 PST. Per your request, attached is a short verification checklist that we'll complete live and finalize as a signed artifact for your audit ticket. The checklist includes:

- replay id run (sanitized): replay-20260114-TF-001
- staging target: staging-1.redwood-internal (ephemeral creds provided)
- pre/post metrics to capture: request_error_rate, p99 latency, token-truncation-count
- evidence artifacts to attach: replay_manifest.json, kv_cache_eviction_trace.log, metrics_snapshot_20260114_21-00-22-00.tar
- sign-off owners: Jonas Weber (Redwood), Nate Reynolds (Trilogy)

We will also bring a short remediation timeline: automated rollout gating to be implemented by Feb 10, enhanced cache-protection rules by Feb 3, and a post-rollout verification sweep scheduled for Feb 17.

Attachment: verification_playbook_20260128.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Mina Haddad
Principal Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
